summary: The Inline Config Provider takes a list of files with Path (overwrites existing), Content, ContentEncoding (plain or base64, default plain), optional Mode (octal like 0644 or decimal like 420, default 0644, setuid/setgid/sticky allowed), User (default root) and Group.
questions: How do I define a configuration file inline in a device spec?
What is the default file mode for inline config files?
Can inline config content be base64 encoded?
How do I set the owner of an inline config file?
